name: it-income-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Italian income tax for self-employed individuals (lavoratori autonomi, liberi professionisti) under regime ordinario. Trigger on phrases like "Modello Redditi PF", "Quadro RE", "IRPEF", "redditi di lavoro autonomo", "imposta sul reddito Italy", "deduzioni", "detrazioni", "addizionale regionale", "addizionale comunale", "regime ordinario", "acconti IRPEF", "no tax area", "INPS Gestione Separata", "rivalsa INPS" or any Italian income tax question for a professional. It covers the 2025 and 2026 periods: IRPEF bands, the art. 13 detrazione, deductions, the addizionali, Quadro RE, filing and penalties. The middle rate is 35% for 2025 and 33% for 2026. Regime forfettario appears only as an entry gate and comparison. This Tier 2 draft supports source checking and reviewer questions; it does not authorise filing, payment or a tax position.
